training: Two independent linear softmax heads, random initialization, CPU only; word, ordered word-bigram, and token character-gram features plus coarse numeric/unit classes. Original training forms have equal mass within each act and each act equal mass within mode.
evaluation: Five entire original forms per class reserved before generating variants. Compute unweighted row precision and coverage AND form-macro precision and coverage, with all labels including negative. Promote only if each mode clears row precision and coverage and form-weighted precision and coverage thresholds. Never convert external negative opening class into an executable action; model makes no tool decisions beyond tentative act proposals. Missing values or ambiguity must defer to host.
